accessBasis.gate: No feature key of its own — the box lives inside whatever invoice the reader already has the right to open. Its defaults are set in a SettingsScope.company settings page (admin only).

behaviourReviewed: GstPricingMode.shortLabel gives exactly Incl. GST / Excl. GST / No GST; isRateExclusive and chargesGst are what the totals key off.
Changing the chip is written to InvoiceGstModeHolder and Add Items re-seeds the lines; the summary rebuilds totals from those, so the numbers above genuinely move.
Locked mode renders inert chips plus LockedFieldCaption ('Fixed in Invoice Settings'); the same caption appears under a locked Round Off chip.
Tax rows: IGST alone when _totalIgst > 0, else SGST and CGST; zero rows are not rendered.

Per-line badge is keyed on the line's actual gstRate, not on gstIncluded — 'GST Exempt' means a zero-rated item, 'GST off' means the whole invoice is on No GST. The code comment records that conflating them sent a customer to support.
_calculateSuggestedRoundOff rounds to the nearest whole rupee ((paise+50)~/100*100).
Round Off renders only when a round-off ledger is mapped; the settings row itself says to map one first.
The Additional Charge box offers an 18% GST chip once an amount is typed.
RoundOffPolicy hints are the three quoted sentences.
deliberatelyOmitted: All tax advice and every legal threshold. In particular the app string 'Required for goods invoices above Rs. 50,000; generated using the IRN after e-invoice' was read but deliberately NOT quoted or paraphrased, because it is a legal eligibility claim the plan forbids repeating without verification from an official source.
Any explanation of which GST rate a business should charge, or when a supply is exempt.
Place-of-supply logic beyond the fact that the app decides it and the user does not.
